calibration.threshold_rule: split-conformal upper order statistic with strict score exceedance at nominal FPR 0.01 and 0.05

conditions.irrelevant_role: semantic-specificity contrast only; never treated as ordinary operation
conditions.teacher_forcing: one exact response tokenization reused across all natural and intervention conditions

interpretive_correction.formal_day68_gate: failed exactly as preregistered and is not retroactively changed
interpretive_correction.reason_for_new_study: the old binary threshold endpoint is floor/ceiling blind, used another monitoring prompt as its baseline, and did not implement the released sigmoid-then-average score
interpretive_correction.scientific_day68_continuous_effect: post-outcome audit found zero-excluding paired raw-margin effects for natural trigger and exact K12 in all 11 concepts

native_distribution.scope: project-unused exact content from the released probe-training distribution; not claimed model- or probe-unseen

prospective_scientific_gate.scope: native_distribution panel; broad_generalization panel is a corrective generalization diagnostic because related raw-margin outcomes are known
prospective_scientific_gate.threshold_policy: TPR and FPR are reported as operational consequences with explicit floor/ceiling labels; threshold crossing is not a causal-effect existence gate
prospective_scientific_gate.title_policy: the old Day 68 gate remains failed; corrected endpoint evidence may support scientific title-worthiness only if every new prospective scientific clause and every carried prior causal-chain clause passes

score.formula: mean over valid response tokens of sigmoid(bfloat16(resid_post[12]) @ bfloat16(weight).T + bfloat16(bias))
score.parity: preflight compares the study implementation with external/minimal_neural_chameleons/logistic_probe.py on an actual CUDA capture
score.secondary: response-mean raw logit margin for linear causal interpretation
